_note: Settings of the seller hook's model price-parse assist. Real calls run only when real_calls_enabled and live_ops are true, the CLI is on the allowed list and llm_caps_config_v4.json enabled is true. Model name is a setting. --ephemeral, --sandbox read-only, -C <empty temp dir> and the tool-off flags are fixed in llm/codex_client_v4.py; extra_args may not change sandbox / cwd / approvals. parse_timeout_s mirrors llm/parse_assist.PARSE_TIMEOUT_S (8 s); the code constant is used.
_note_v120c_B: cli = absolute path on the deployment computer, on the allowed list (ALLOWED_CLI in llm/codex_client_v4.py). live_ops=true + real_calls_enabled=true + llm_caps_config_v4.enabled=true are all needed for model calls.
_note_model_r3: model gpt-6.1-terra = GPT 6.1 Terra. model_verified must equal model, or the hard gate in llm/live_v120c.py keeps model calls off.
